topIssues.title: [L2CM] Add ProxyAdminOwnedBase access control to predeploy initialize() functions
topIssues.author: aliersh
topIssues.body:
**FMA follow-up (FM1):** As identified in the [L2CM FMA](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/blob/main/security/fma-l2cm.md), the L2CM upgrade mechanism clears the `initialized` slot and re-calls `initialize()` on predeploy proxies. If `initialize()` is open to anyone post-upgrade, an attacker could front-run or re-initialize with malicious parameters.

All predeploy contracts that have an `initialize()` function should use [`ProxyAdminOwnedBase._assertOnlyProxyAdminOrProxyAdminOwner()`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/develop/packages/contracts-bedrock/src/L1/ProxyAdminOwnedBase.sol#L101) to restrict who can call `initialize()`.

### Acceptance Criteria

- All proxied L2 predeploy `initialize()` functions are protected with `ProxyAdminOwnedBase` access control
- Tests verify that `initialize()` reverts when called by unauthorized addresses

### References

- [L2CM FMA — FM1: Re-initialization State Corruption](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/blob/main/security/fma-l2cm.md)

topIssues.author: pcw109550
topIssues.body:
**CI run:** https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/ethereum-optimism/optimism/120674/workflows/ecf36f03-9e03-4966-8b99-ffd83e51d849/jobs/4667174
**Date:** 2026-03-25

**Error:**
```
Error: Received unexpected error:
       execution reverted: Ownable: caller is not the owner
Test:  TestPreinteropFaultProofs_TraceExtensionActivation
Messages: migrate delegatecall failed: execution reverted: Ownable: caller is not the owner
```

**Stack trace:**
```
op-devstack/sysgo/superroot.go:253
op-devstack/sysgo/multichain_proofs.go:120
op-devstack/sysgo/multichain_proofs.go:161
op-devstack/presets/interop.go:129
op-acceptance-tests/tests/isthmus/preinterop/setup_test.go:9
op-acceptance-tests/tests/isthmus/preinterop/interop_fault_proofs_test.go:21
```

The test fails during `migrate delegatecall` with an ownership check error, suggesting a race condition or ordering issue in the test setup where the caller doesn't have ownership at the time of the migration call.

topPRs.title: fix(kona/derive): use walked-back system config on pipeline reset
topPRs.author: sebastianst
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Fixes the pipeline initialization bug where kona used the system config from the L2 safe head during reset, instead of the system config from the walked-back L2 block whose L1 origin is `channel_timeout` blocks behind. If the batcher address changes within that window, derivation diverges from op-node.

**Issue:** ethereum-optimism/optimism-private#452

### Changes

- **`DerivationPipeline::initial_reset()`** — New method implementing op-node's `initialReset` L2 walkback algorithm. Walks back L2 parents until the L1 origin is at most `channel_timeout` blocks behind the safe head's L1 origin, producing both the correct L1 origin and system config from the same block.

- **`StageReset` trait** — Replaces internal `SignalReceiver` usage on stages with direct method calls (`reset`, `activate`, `flush_channel`, `provide_block`).

- **`activate()` is a parameterless soft reset** — Clears buffered channels and batches but preserves derivation state (origin, epoch tracking, system config). No walkback, no parameters. Batch stages override to skip epoch clearing.

- **Simplified `Signal` types** — `ResetSignal` and `ActivationSignal` now only carry `l2_safe_head`. No optional fields, no `l1_origin`, no `system_config`. The pipeline is the single authority for computing these on reset.

- **Traversal stages** resolve `BlockNumHash` → `BlockInfo` via their `ChainProvider` during reset.

- **`BatchQueue`/`BatchValidator`** read origin from `OriginProvider` after reset propagation, not from signal parameters.

- **Removed redundant walkback** from `Engine::reset()` (node). Simplified return type to `L2BlockInfo`.

## Test plan

- [x] 3 new unit tests for `initial_reset()`: walkback with batcher change, genesis boundary, zero timeout
- [x] All 210 existing kona-derive tests pass
- [x] `cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings` clean
- [x] `cargo check --all-features` clean across all affected crates
- [x] Nightly `rustfmt` clean
- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] Follow-up: `op-e2e/actions/proofs` test for batcher change within channel_timeout (stacked branch)

🤖 *Generated by Claude Code*
